verdict.rationale: Gide has published on at least one jurisdiction-specific startup instrument: an insight on French BSPCE taxation under the 2026 finance law. It also runs a dedicated employee share schemes team covering 'France and internationally'. However, the evidence shows publications only on French instruments, not on other markets. Missing for 10: published content on non-French instruments (UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules), evidence of more than a single insight title, and any independent corroboration of the firm's thought-leadership output.
